chunks: And verily, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What are the two primary attributes of God mentioned in this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse concludes the dialogue between Prophet Muhammad and the disbelievers, affirming that despite their rejection, God’s absolute sovereignty (Al-Aziz) ensures the ultimate triumph of truth, while His mercy (Al-Rahim) offers hope for guidance. Shia exegesis highlights this duality as a source of comfort for the faithful, illustrating that divine power is never arbitrary but always coupled with benevolent care for creation.
